displayName: OCI-PCI-022: PCI-DSS — Clock Synchronization Failure in CDE
description:
Detects time synchronization failures in cardholder data environment affecting audit log integrity

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: pci-dss — clock synchronization failure in cde

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_pci_022", "data__json.rEventName" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'AuditEvents' AND "data__json.rEventName" LIKE '%pci%' AND "value" > 0
